Here are some tidbits that didn't make it into the session materials but might be useful.

## Listing Objects

`ls()` will print the names of all objects you currently have in your environment, such as dataframes and vectors. This can be helpful when you accumulate many objects and need to remind yourself the name of a dataframe you're looking for.
